items.title: Moon rocks a symbol of China's global vision
items.description: One of the most memorable advertising tag lines in the United States was "You've come a long way, baby". The phrase can also be used to describe China's meteoric rise in the past few decades. Nothing proves this point better than a recent ceremony at the United Nations headquarters in Vienna, Austria, where China presented moon rocks and soil samples from the far side of the Moon for permanent display. The out-of-this-world gift has transformed China's scientific achievement into a lasting diplomatic symbol at the heart of multilateralism.
